user.title: Stopfinder
user.description: Sign in with the same email and password you use in the Stopfinder app. Your district must have Stopfinder enabled.

reauth_confirm.description: Stopfinder stopped accepting the saved credentials for {username}. Enter the password again.

abort.already_configured: This Stopfinder account is already set up.

init.title: Stopfinder options
init.description: Position and geo alerts are checked only while a trip is running. Announcements use a wider window around the day's trips, so a late-bus notice is caught before the bus is due. Outside those windows nothing is requested.

data.announcement_lead_hours: Hours before the first trip to start checking announcements
data.announcement_trail_hours: Hours after the last trip to keep checking announcements
